113.DSCR:
A nation that once existed in Northern Europe, ruled by the $$ピースクラフト$$ royal family.
It upheld complete pacifism, but was destroyed by the $$地球圏統一連合$$, which feared that the spread of that ideology would bring disadvantage to itself.

114.DSCR:
Refers to a system built with the aim of restoring the Earth's environment in the world that later came to be called $$黒歴史$$, or to the unmanned units that act under the management of that system.
It was prepared after the wars of $$黒歴史$$ to restore the devastated environment and to eliminate anything that stood in the way of that. However, after the end of the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$, it came to recognize the existence of humanity as a target for elimination and began to act.
When $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ defeated its master system, all the systems stopped.

115.DSCR:
Commander of the $$クルーゼ隊$$, an elite unit of the $$ザフト$$ military.
A man of many mysteries who always hid his true face behind a mask and gave off an air of danger.
He not only went to the front as a pilot with advanced piloting skill, but was also an excellent military strategist, and racked up numerous achievements through his sharp judgment and, at times, a ruthless capacity for action that stopped at no means if it served his goal.
Trusted by $$パトリック$$, and also holding a high position in the military, he had a certain amount of say with the $$プラント$$ Council.
His true identity is a clone of $$ムウ$$'s father, $$アル・ダ・フラガ$$, but because his telomeres, which govern the length of a lifespan, were short, he had been branded a failure.
Out of despair at being unable to find his own existence anywhere in the world, he convinced himself that he was the judge of the world, and out of that warped thinking he plotted to bring about the extinction of humanity.
After learning the true identity of $$キラ$$, he stubbornly denied the existence of $$キラ$$, who, though likewise one of the 'created', was a success, and fought a fierce battle to the death in the Second Battle of $$ヤキン・ドゥーエ$$.
In the end he was defeated by $$キラ$$, and vanished, engulfed in the light of the giant gamma-ray laser cannon '$$ジェネシス$$'.

116.DSCR:
A concept for a social system proposed by $$ギルバート・デュランダル$$, Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
It aims at efficient management of society by analyzing genes to investigate each person's aptitudes and abilities and, based on the results, placing each individual in the occupation or post suited to their abilities.
With destiny decided, anxiety about the future is resolved, but opposition movements arose on the grounds that it would produce a closed society that robbed people of free will. $$デュランダル$$ tried to suppress them by force, and this led to war.
$$デュランダル$$ was struck down by a faction that took $$ラクス・クライン$$ as its banner, and the plan came to a halt.

117.DSCR:
Refers to $$ジョン・ジョージ・コートニー$$, a retired lieutenant colonel of the U.S. military.
A former soldier brimming with the Marine Corps spirit.
He is an old friend of $$ミスリル$$'s Admiral $$ボーダ$$, and also a huge fan of $$テッサ$$.

proofread.reason: omitted subject/verb: 旧友であり...大ファンでもある is a predicate about Courtney (male per glossary); the English left a verbless fragment with no subject

118.DSCR:
A Lambda Driver observation device developed by $$クダン・ミラ$$.
It is mounted on AS units, and when it is used, the external monitor takes on a state as if a green filter had been applied, and the effective range and strength of Lambda Drivers are displayed in shades of color.
With this, the movements of enemy units equipped with Lambda Drivers can be checked, and by using tactics such as attacking from a distance or direction the enemy's attention is not directed toward, it became possible to defeat them even in an M9.

119.DSCR:
The incident in which $$アレギウム$$, the holy land of $$マーティアル$$, had its defense units broken through by a single AT piloted by $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, and its cathedral was attacked.
The cause of the incident was that Cardinal $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ 'touched' $$キリコ$$, whom $$テオ８世$$ had declared 'the Untouchable', and as a result of this affair the authority of the church collapsed.

120.DSCR:
A $$時空震動|lc$$ experiment conducted in the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ of the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
Not only did it fail to generate a $$時空震動|lc$$, it also distorted spacetime outside the place where the experiment was conducted.
The first $$次元獣$$ in history appeared from it, and the town of $$オーティス$$ was wiped out, leaving only $$エスター・エルハス$$. $$クロウ・ブルースト$$, who belonged to $$ファイヤバグ$$ and had been dispatched to clean up afterward, opposed the captain, $$マリリン・キャット$$, who feared the trouble and tried to kill $$エスター・エルハス$$, and protected her life.
Incidentally, owing to the failure of this experiment and its effects on the surroundings at the time, the project came to be frozen.

122.DSCR:
Also called the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ transfer reaction, it is a system that embeds minute crystalline electronic elements inside the structural materials throughout the whole body and links them three-dimensionally, thereby reading the electrical patterns in the operator's brain and transcribing them onto an AI unit.
The name is taken from the initials of 'Transfer And Response $$オムニ・スフィア$$'.
It is also installed in the '$$レディ・チャペル$$' of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, where it makes it possible for one person to pilot the huge submarine alone through the power of a $$ウィスパード$$.

123.DSCR:
The largest $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$, built on $$メリダ島$$ by $$レナード$$.
A device that makes it possible to transform the world as one wishes by using the power of $$かなめ$$, it is used in $$レナード$$'s plan to correct the history that was distorted by the existence of the $$ウィスパード$$.

124.DSCR:
Prime Minister of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world.
She was originally the Director of the Bureau of Science and Technology, and after $$インサラウム$$ was destroyed by the $$破界の王$$, she was appointed Prime Minister amid the chaos and advised Prince $$ユーサー$$ to invade the parallel world.
She devoted her life to the forbidden pursuit of dimensional science, and the fruits of her research, the artificial $$次元獣$$ series, became a major military force in $$インサラウム$$'s invasion of Earth.
In the final battle on Mars in the $$再世戦争$$, she transformed herself into the artificial $$次元獣$$ $$エクサ・アダモン$$ and fought, but was defeated by $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ and met her end.
Her death also brought $$インサラウム$$'s research into dimensional science to a standstill.

126.DSCR:
Her full name is $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.
Vice commander of $$ジェミニス$$, a special unit that belonged to $$サイデリアル$$.
A calm, composed, and capable commander, she was also a first-rate pilot of mobile weapons, and boasted astonishing combat power by reflecting her own psychokinetic power directly in her piloting.
For the sake of carrying out her missions she was thoroughly ruthless, and if the other party was an enemy, she could even commit acts that could be called cruel and inhuman.
Inwardly, however, she was conflicted about what they were doing, and there was also an aspect of her deliberately acting coldly in order to shake that off.
The last woman of the $$ジェミナイド$$s, the inhabitants of Planet $$ジェミナイ$$.
The partner of $$ジェミニス$$ commander $$ガドライト#pilot$$ in both public and private life, and carrying their child.
The heredity of the $$ジェミナイド$$s is completely matrilineal-dominant, and even when they mate with another race, as long as the mother is a $$ジェミナイド$$, her genes are certain to take priority. Conversely, when there are no women, the $$ジェミナイド$$s cannot pass the genes of their race on to their descendants.
After $$ガドライト#pilot$$ fell, she was executed by $$尸空#pilot$$.

After $$ガドライト#pilot$$ fell, she was executed by $$尸空#pilot$$, but the child in her belly was unharmed, and twin daughters who would come to be named $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$ were born.

127.DSCR:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
The commander is $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, and the vice commander is $$ダバラーン・タウ$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＨＩＡ$$ and the $$アルデバル$$.
Originally a fighting group that wandered the galaxy, active as pirates or mercenaries, it was incorporated into $$サイデリアル$$ after the death in battle of the previous chief, $$エルーナルーナ$$'s father.
The members hold that life is to be found only amid gunfire, and under $$エルーナルーナ$$'s command they cheerfully enjoy battle.

128.DSCR:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
It is read 'Kishuku'.
The commander is $$尸空#pilot$$ and the vice commander is $$尸刻$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＣＡＮ$$ and the $$尸冥爪$$.
Originally a race living on the frontier of the galaxy, whose mission was to govern the 'power that seeks to vanish' within humans, that is, death. However, $$サイデリアル$$ set its sights on that power, destroyed the whole clan, and incorporated them into $$サイデリアル$$ as they were.
The members control $$次元力$$ by manipulating the 'power that seeks to vanish', and with it they pilot the $$尸冥爪$$.

129.DSCR:
A special unit of the $$新地球連邦軍$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
There are up to three squads under Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ as commander, and it is made up of their respective captains, $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$, $$シュラン・オペル$$ and $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$, and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, who is in charge of the research and development division.
Its purpose was to establish order in the confused world immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, but that purpose was full of self-righteousness and was synonymous with conquering the world.
After its ringleader $$エーデル$$ was defeated, the mastermind $$ジエー$$, in the true form of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, challenged $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ but was defeated, and $$カイメラ$$ was annihilated as well.
129.DSC2:
A special unit of the $$新地球連邦軍$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
There are up to three squads under Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ as commander, and it is made up of their respective captains, $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$, $$シュラン・オペル$$ and $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$, and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, who is in charge of the research and development division.
Its purpose was to establish order in the confused world immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, but that purpose was full of self-righteousness and was synonymous with conquering the world.
After its ringleader $$エーデル$$ was defeated, the mastermind $$ジエー$$, in the true form of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, challenged $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ but was defeated, and $$カイメラ$$ was annihilated as well.
It was later revealed that its very existence had been part of $$ジエー$$'s plan to overthrow the $$御使い$$.

130.DSCR:
His full name is $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.
The mastermind behind the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.
He created $$エーデル・ベルナル$$, the ringleader of $$カイメラ$$ and a brigadier general of the Earth Federation Forces, and controlled world affairs in order to play in a free world of his own desire.
He succeeded in a limited control of the Power of Origin ($$オリジン・ロー$$ / $$次元力$$), and using that power, behaves however his desires lead him. His guiding principle is summed up in a single phrase: 'As long as it's interesting!', and he enjoys the existence of the multitude of worlds born from the $$時空震動弾$$ more than anyone else.
Through his application of the Power of Origin, he has integrated the abilities of his multiple selves existing across parallel worlds, and surpasses ordinary people in every respect.
He is also freed from concepts such as ethics and morality, and since he is driven by desires that others find hard to understand, it is difficult to read his intentions or actions.
It is said that he unraveled the Power of Origin by coming into contact with the $$黒の英知$$ through $$エルガン・ローディック$$, the same person as him in a parallel world.
His true form is a beautiful young man, but until the final battle he played the role of the ugly old scientist $$ジエー・ベイベル$$.
Also, the name '$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$' is merely one of convenience, and his real name is something else.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: エルガン・ローディックにより黒の英知に触れた = HE (the Edel) came into contact with the Black Wisdom through/by way of Elgan (not 'Elgan touched the Black Wisdom'); rules: double quotes changed to single quotes for the phrase and the name (2 places). All tokens kept.

131.DSCR:
Nanomachines generated by a $$次元将$$.
They fuse the lives of a mobile weapon and its pilot to cause conversion into a $$次元獣$$ (= $$ヴァイオレイション$$), giving birth to a $$次元獣$$.
Which grade of $$次元獣$$ it becomes at that time is determined by the original unit, its pilot, and their combat power.

132.DSCR:
Twin sisters who are $$トップレス$$ belonging to the $$フラタニティ$$.
The older sister is $$ピアジェ$$ and the younger sister is $$ルクルト$$.
Both wear full-body suits and heavy makeup, and have taken the post of general chairperson of the operation to excavate the $$変動重力源|lc$$ on $$タイタン$$, a moon of Jupiter, in which capacity they carry out the revival of the $$変動重力源|lc$$.
They often eat meat called 'Titan crab'.
132.DSC2:
Twin sisters who are $$トップレス$$ belonging to the $$フラタニティ$$.
The older sister is $$ピアジェ$$ and the younger sister is $$ルクルト$$.
They are a rare type of $$トップレス$$ whose ability manifests in twins, and perhaps because of that ability, in order to stay together the two scheme in pursuit of an 'eternally lasting $$トップレス$$'.
They belong to a mysterious organization called the $$秘密サークル$$.
As part of human experiments to sustain $$トップレス$$, they ate the meat of the $$タイタン変動重力源$$, which they called 'Titan crab'.
The members and collaborators of the $$秘密サークル$$ are found everywhere, from the government of the imperial capital to corporations, financial circles, university and research institute think tanks, and the space military. Even the Buster Machine '$$カランドゥ$$' that the twins ride is originally sealed, and is used as a special exception by means of that circle's political power.
They believe that the $$変動重力源|lc$$ sleeping on $$タイタン$$ is a '$$トップレス$$ from another star'. They took the post of general chairperson of the operation to excavate it and revived the $$変動重力源|lc$$, but their actions ended in an ironic result for the twins: both of them died from the attack of the revived $$変動重力源|lc$$.

133.DSCR:
Technology related to modification of the human body.
In the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ it is widely adopted even at the citizen level, and its range is broad, from cyborgization of the skeleton, muscles and so on to technology for handling audiovisual data through brain implant devices.
In the $$フロンティア船団$$ and others, except for medical purposes, it is in principle illegal.

134.DSCR:
A skilled pilot raised on the Moon and called a 'genius of space combat'. She challenged $$カズミ$$, who had only just gone up into space, to a duel, and after the duel was over she treated $$カズミ$$ warmly; her emotions swing so violently that one might suspect a split personality.
Her strictness in battle is thorough, and there were times she gave up on $$ノリコ$$ when $$ノリコ$$ was about to be crushed by fear.
She was paired with $$ノリコ$$ as a pilot of the $$ガンバスター$$ after $$カズミ$$ married $$コーチ$$, but in the final battle she handed the $$ガンバスター$$ over to $$カズミ$$. She herself fought the space monsters in the $$シズラー$$ and survived safely.

proofread.reason: wrong referent: in 'After Kazumi married Coach, she was paired with Noriko' the pronoun 'she' reads as Kazumi (the only woman named in the clause) but the Japanese subject is the entry's own person (Jung, who is not named); reordered so the entry subject opens the sentence and 'she' stays with her. No token changed.
